files.t: Minimum Cardinality of generating set of a submodule
files.s: In this file, we define the minimum cardinality of a generating set for a submodule, which is implemented as `spanFinrank` and `spanRank`. `spanFinrank` takes value in `ℕ` and equals `0` when no finite generating set exists. `spanRank` takes value as a cardinal.

h.d: The minimum cardinality of a generating set of a submodule as a natural number. If no finite generating set exists, it is defined to be `0`.
The minimum cardinality of a generating set of a submodule as a cardinal.
For a finitely generated submodule, get a set of generating elements with minimal cardinality.
Any submodule has a generating set of cardinality equal to `spanRank`.

For a ring `R` (not necessarily commutative) satisfying `StrongRankCondition R`, if `M` is an `R`-module, then the `spanRank` of `M` is less than or equal to the rank of M.
